technology: Laravel 12, PHP, Inertia, React 18, TypeScript, JavaScript, Blade/HTML, Tailwind/CSS

reliability_notes.graphtyn_bootstrap: Timed out after 600 seconds before OpenCode emitted a tool call; recorded as infrastructure/model failure, not factual evidence.
reliability_notes.baseline_bootstrap: OpenCode made 22 calls but emitted no final answer.
reliability_notes.conclusion: Graphtyn is not yet competitive on Laravel cross-stack recovery. PHP currently uses the generic fallback rather than a precise Tree-sitter PHP/Laravel relationship extractor. Low token use here reflects missing evidence, not an efficiency win.
